plain_language: These are deaths in 34 public hospitals, so they don’t capture women who died at home or in private facilities.
With no exact count of hospital births, the death rate uses an estimate (half of births in facilities, 40% of those in hospitals), so the ratio is indicative, not precise.
More women delivering in hospitals over time means more deaths are recorded there, which partly drives the rising count.
Causes come from paper registers and ICD-10 forms; some deaths may be misclassified or under-recorded, especially indirect causes.
